SELECT
       /* ============================================================
          REQUEST
          ============================================================ */
       r.REQUEST_ID,
       RAWTOHEX(r.REQUEST_ID) AS REQUEST_ID_HEX,

       r.CONTRACT_SERIAL,
       r.CONTRACT_PDF_REF,
       r.BANK_SHEET_REF,
       r.RECEIVED_AT,
       r.REQUEST_DATE,
       r.PREVIOUS_REQUEST_DATE,
       r.REQUEST_COMMENT,

       /* ============================================================
          STATUS
          ============================================================ */
       r.STATUS_ID,
       RAWTOHEX(r.STATUS_ID) AS STATUS_ID_HEX,
       s.STATUS_CODE,
       s.STATUS_NAME,
       s.FLOW_STATUS_STEP_NO,
       r.CURRENT_STAGE,

       /* ============================================================
          MAKER
          ============================================================ */
       r.MAKER_ID,
       r.MAKER_ACTION,
       r.MAKER_AT,

       /* ============================================================
          FRAUD
          ============================================================ */
       r.FRAUD_ID,
       r.FRAUD_ACTION,
       r.FRAUD_AT,

       /* ============================================================
          CHECKER
          ============================================================ */
       r.CHECKER_ID,
       r.CHECKER_ACTION,
       r.CHECKER_AT,

       /* ============================================================
          REJECTION / PUSHBACK
          ============================================================ */
       r.REJECT_REASON_CODE,
       r.REJECT_REASON_DESC,
       r.BANK_PUSHBACK_NOTE,

       /* ============================================================
          AUDIT
          ============================================================ */
       r.CREATED_AT,
       r.UPDATED_AT,
       r.CREATED_BY,
       r.UPDATED_BY,

       /* ============================================================
          REQUEST-LEVEL ASSIGNMENTS
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX(r.RM_ID) AS RM_ID,
       RAWTOHEX(r.TEAM_LEADER_ID) AS TEAM_LEADER_ID,
       RAWTOHEX(r.RMS_ORACLE_ID) AS RMS_ORACLE_ID,

       rm.RM_NAME AS RM_NAME,
       rm.RM_ORACLE_CODE AS RM_ORACLE_CODE,

       tl.RM_NAME AS TEAM_LEADER_NAME,
       tl.RM_ORACLE_CODE AS TEAM_LEADER_ORACLE_CODE,

       rms.RM_NAME AS RMS_ORACLE_NAME,
       rms.RM_ORACLE_CODE AS RMS_ORACLE_CODE,

       /* ============================================================
          MERCHANT
          ============================================================ */
       RAWTOHEX(m.MERCHANT_ID) AS MERCHANT_ID_HEX,
       m.CIF,
       m.NATIONAL_ID,
       m.OWNER_NAME_AR,
       m.COMPANY_NAME,
       m.COMPANY_NAME_AR,
       m.CONTRACT_MDR_VALUE,
       m.MERCHANT_NAME_EN,
       m.MERCHANT_NAME_AR,

       /* ============================================================
          CONTACT
          ============================================================ */
       m.CONTACT_NAME_AR,
       m.MOBILE_PRIMARY,
       m.ADDRESS_EN,
       m.ADDRESS_AR,

       /* ============================================================
          LOCATION
          ============================================================ */
       m.CITY,
       m.REGION,
       m.BRANCH_CODE,

       /* ============================================================
          COMMERCIAL
          ============================================================ */
       m.BANK_ACCOUNT,
       m.MCC_ID,
       RAWTOHEX(m.MCC_ID) AS MCC_ID_HEX,
       m.PACKAGE_ID,
       RAWTOHEX(m.PACKAGE_ID) AS PACKAGE_ID_HEX,
       m.CONTRACT_MDR,
       m.OTHER_POS_COMMISSION

FROM TALY_BO_REP.MMS_ONBOARDING_REQUEST r

LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_REQUEST_STATUS s
       ON s.STATUS_ID = r.STATUS_ID

JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_MERCHANT m
       ON m.MERCHANT_ID = r.MERCHANT_ID
      AND m.IS_DELETED = 0

/* RM */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS rm
       ON rm.RM_ID = r.RM_ID

/* Team Leader */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS tl
       ON tl.RM_ID = r.TEAM_LEADER_ID

/* RMS Oracle */
LEFT JOIN TALY_BO_REP.MMS_RMS rms
       ON rms.RM_ID = r.RMS_ORACLE_ID

WHERE r.REQUEST_ID =
      HEXTORAW(
          REPLACE(
              '{{ appsmith.URL.queryParams.requestId }}',
              '-',
              ''
          )
      )
  AND r.IS_DELETED = 0
